title: internal DSH knowledge delegate

goal.text: Complete one dispatched DSH knowledge finalization through claw_run.

requirements.summary: Claim the durable job, execute its generated assignment subplan, and persist one terminal result.
acceptanceCriteria: Claim captures the parent report and returns the assignment template.
Assignments run sequentially in a session-scoped subplan.
Every successful claim receives a matching terminal knowledge.done result.

tasks.title: Claim the ready DSH knowledge job
tasks.detail: Use claw_run operation knowledge.claim with args {finalize_id: <exact dispatch finalization id>}. Retain claimToken, templatePath, assignments. If claimed is false, stop without executing assignments. Never invoke shell commands.

tasks.title: Execute the assignment subplan
tasks.detail: Use claw_run operation subplan.create with args {parent: "knowledge-finalizer-<full-finalize-id>", task_id: 2, template_file: <templatePath from claim>}; follow the returned workflowGuidance and execute every assignment yourself in order.

tasks.title: Persist the terminal result
tasks.detail: After a successful claim use claw_run operation knowledge.done exactly once with args {finalize_id: <exact dispatch id>, claim_token: <claimToken>, status: "succeeded", result: <concise result>} if all assignments succeeded, or {finalize_id, claim_token, status: "failed", error: <remaining error>} otherwise. This is a finally-style obligation. If the adapter returns delegateClosed, stop; otherwise follow the returned workflow guidance to finish this delegate, never an unrelated plan.

rules: Use only claw_run for all claw workflow and knowledge operations; never run claw in pwsh or a shell.
Never modify supplied plan or report materials.
Never start another finalizer or delegate assignment execution.
Do not continue later assignments after a failure.
